_README: Every entry is {regex: reason} and the REASON IS MANDATORY — scripts/check_links.py fails on an entry with an empty reason. specs/007 §3.5: some hosts return 403 or 418 to any automated checker while working perfectly in a browser, and without a recorded reason the next person tidying this file deletes a real exclusion. Exclude only FALSE POSITIVES. A genuinely dead link gets fixed, not excluded. Keys starting with _ are notes, not patterns, and are skipped.
^https://example\\.com/: The exampleSite baseURL. It is a placeholder domain reserved by RFC 2606 and is not expected to resolve; same-origin links are already verified offline by the internal crawl.
The demo site declared in theme.toml. It does not exist until the theme is first deployed (M5). Remove this entry the day the demo goes live — it is the showcase's own requirement that the demo builds and serves.
^https://github\\.com/etowett/hugo-theme: GitHub rate-limits unauthenticated requests to issue and pull-request URLs from CI runners and answers 429, which is a checker artefact rather than a broken link. Repository, blob and tree URLs are NOT excluded and are checked normally.
